purpose: post-hoc frozen-checkpoint Monte Carlo precision diagnostic
case_selection: unchanged first 16 validation histories; no cases dropped
limits: Mean Monte Carlo SE assumes independent neural draws from the frozen approximate posterior; it excludes neural approximation and reference error. Three seed ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Shared future innovations do not couple posterior draws. Finite grid/particle refinement is not an exact posterior certificate. These inspected validation histories are not an independent SBC sample or a new held-out acceptance test.
